failure_patterns: Chromium exits immediately (SIGTRAP) in this environment; use jsdom harness for UI runtime verification instead of Playwright screenshots.
SQLAlchemy async session with expire_on_commit=False: avoid refresh() after commit; access relationships before returning from session scope.
SQLite does not support JSONB type; use JSON type for cross-dialect compatibility.
success_patterns: Extract design template/component/styles programmatically to preserve fidelity instead of hand-copying 1100+ lines.
Recreate template nodes via createElementNS(node.namespaceURI) so SVG subtrees render; detect events via lowercased on* attribute names.
Use selectinload() for eager-loading relationships in async SQLAlchemy to avoid MissingGreenlet errors.
Use session.add() for new related objects instead of assigning to relationship lists to avoid lazy-load triggers.
